title: Settings
description: Branding, home page sections, feature flags, map tiles, sharing and legal links used by the apps (published through /app-config).
readOnly: Read-only: changing settings requires the settings.write permission.

general.title: Defaults
general.description: Language and market used when a visitor has not chosen one. Language and market are independent.
general.defaultMarketHint: Only enabled markets can be the default. Manage markets in Administration → Markets.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: App name, logo and colours shown in the mobile app and this admin.
branding.logoHint: Upload a licensed logo (PNG, JPEG or WebP, max 1 MB — stored and re-encoded by the server) or enter the URL of an image you are allowed to use. HTTPS is required in production.
branding.contrastLow: Low contrast with white text {{ratio}}:1 — below WCAG AA (4.5:1)
branding.logoRules: PNG, JPEG or WebP, at least 64 px, max 1 MB. SVG is not accepted.
branding.logoBlocked: Save or discard your changes first.
branding.logoType: Only PNG, JPEG or WebP images can be uploaded.
branding.logoTooLarge: The file is larger than 1 MB.

homeSections.title: Home page sections
homeSections.description: Drag or use the arrows to reorder; switch off to hide a section. Sections are defined by the apps; hidden sections stay browsable elsewhere.
homeSections.emptyBody: The server has not provided any home sections (setting key home.sections).

features.title: Feature flags
features.description: Turn app features on or off.
features.integrationNote: A flag cannot make an unconfigured integration work: features that need an external service (routing, push, assistant…) stay unavailable until the service is configured — see System → Integrations.
features.emptyBody: The server has not provided any feature flags (setting key features).

map.title: Map tiles
map.description: Tile server and attribution used by the station map in the apps.
map.tileUrlHint: Must contain {z}, {x} and {y} ({s} and {r} are allowed). HTTPS is required in production.
map.attributionHint: Shown on the map as required by the tile provider's licence (e.g. © OpenStreetMap contributors).
map.invalidTemplate: Use an http(s):// URL containing {z}, {x} and {y}
map.attributionRequired: Attribution is required when a tile server is set
map.licenceNote: Respect the tile provider's usage policy and attribution requirements. The public OpenStreetMap tile servers are not meant for heavy production traffic; use a commercial or self-hosted tile server for production.
map.notConfigured: No tile server configured: the apps report the map as not configured.
map.tileFailed: The tile could not be loaded. Check the template, the provider's access rules or API key.

share.title: Sharing
share.description: Base URL of public share links (news, cars, comparisons) and app links.

restoreDefaultBody: The stored value is replaced by the built-in default. The change is written to the audit log.

codes.osm_public_tile_usage_policy: The public OpenStreetMap tile server is configured. Its usage policy forbids heavy production traffic: use a commercial or self-hosted tile server before launch.
codes.privacy_url_missing: No privacy policy URL yet: the apps cannot link to one.
codes.terms_url_missing: No terms of use URL yet: the apps cannot link to them.
codes.android_fingerprints_missing: No Android signing certificate fingerprint: App Links cannot be verified (assetlinks.json stays empty).
codes.ios_team_id_missing: No Apple team id: Universal Links cannot be verified (apple-app-site-association stays empty).
codes.stored_value_invalid_default_used: The stored value is invalid; the apps currently receive the built-in default. Save a valid value or restore the default.
codes.features_not_implemented_hidden: Some features enabled here are not built yet, so they stay hidden from the apps until they ship.
codes.trip_planner_hidden_routing_not_configur: The trip planner stays hidden from the apps: no routing provider is configured.
codes.assistant_hidden_not_configured: The assistant stays hidden from the apps: no LLM provider is configured.
codes.map_not_configured: The map is not configured (tile URL template or attribution missing).
codes.share_base_url_not_https: The share base URL does not use https in production.

appLinks.title: App links
appLinks.description: Android App Links and iOS Universal Links for evcar.news share links (/n/…, /cars/…, /compare/…). The server publishes /.well-known/assetlinks.json and apple-app-site-association from these values; this setting is not sent to the apps.
appLinks.iosTeamIdHint: 10 characters from the Apple Developer account (empty until the account exists).
appLinks.fingerprintsHint: One per line (upper-case hex pairs separated by colons). Use the release/Play App Signing certificate, not the debug key.
appLinks.pathsHint: One path pattern per line, e.g. /n/*
appLinks.invalidId: Use a reverse-domain id such as news.evcar.app
appLinks.invalidFingerprint: Each line must be a SHA-256 fingerprint: 32 hex pairs separated by colons
appLinks.invalidPath: Each line must start with / and contain only letters, digits, / _ * . -
